summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Listrix MVP UPGRADE. All features working perfectly with NEW schema (name/description/condition/image/cost). Backend APIs functional with proper validation (422 for empty required fields), frontend UI clean and responsive, AI generation working excellently, event logging operational with UPPERCASE event types (ITEM_CREATED, LISTING_GENERATED). Dashboard correctly reflects newly created items and listings. No bugs found.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/ - API Root returns 200
Backend: POST /api/items - Creates item with NEW schema (name/description/condition/image/cost)
Backend: POST /api/items - Validation returns 422 for empty required fields and negative cost
Backend: GET /api/items - Returns list of items (newest first)
Backend: POST /api/ai/generate - Generates AI listing with NEW schema, persists listing
Backend: GET /api/listings - Returns list of AI-generated listings (newest first)
Backend: GET /api/events - Returns events list with proper structure
Backend: Event logging - ITEM_CREATED and LISTING_GENERATED events logged (UPPERCASE)
Frontend: Home page loads with hero, NO step1/step2 tutorial cards, CTAs to Upload and Dashboard
Frontend: Upload Item page has all form fields (Name, Description, Condition dropdown, Cost optional, Image upload optional)
Frontend: Form validation shows error toast for empty required fields (name/description/condition)
Frontend: Save Item button creates item, shows success toast and 'Item saved ✓' indicator
Frontend: Generate Listing button triggers AI generation with loading state (spinner)
Frontend: AI-generated listing displays result panel with title, description, suggested price ($), hashtags
Frontend: Copy button appears after AI generation
Frontend: Dashboard page loads with 4 stat cards (Items, AI Listings, Total Events, Errors)
Frontend: Dashboard Recent Items panel shows items with name, condition, cost, timestamp
Frontend: Dashboard AI Generated Listings panel shows listings with title, price, description, hashtags
Frontend: Dashboard Activity Feed shows events (ITEM_CREATED, LISTING_GENERATED) with proper formatting
Frontend: Dashboard Refresh button reloads data successfully
Frontend: Dashboard New Item button navigates to Upload page
Frontend: Navigation - Home CTAs navigate to Upload and Dashboard pages correctly
